annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) - Analysis of the final compromise text with a view to agreement
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) - Analysis of the final compromise text with a view to agreement
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of the European Union, Presidency
annotation.venue: Council of the European Union document register (ST 5662/24)
annotation.summary_en: Council Presidency note to Coreper presenting the final compromise text of the EU AI Act after the December 2023 trilogue, with the full consolidated text annexed. It sets a risk-based regime with prohibited practices, high-risk requirements, general-purpose AI model rules, governance and sandboxes. Product-embedded AI is addressed through Annex II harmonisation legislation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk-based tiers: prohibited practices (Art. 5), high-risk systems (Annex III), GPAI models with systemic risk.
Prohibits untargeted facial image scraping, workplace/education emotion recognition, and limited predictive policing; real-time remote biometric ID restricted with exceptions.
High-risk systems need risk management, conformity assessment, and human oversight; deployers in some sectors conduct fundamental rights impact assessments.
Products with AI under Annex II harmonisation legislation can integrate AI Act compliance into existing procedures.
AI Office, regulatory sandboxes, and real-world testing outside sandboxes with safeguards.
